A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Tool-Planner and contain 49 readable pages, including Appendices A-K. Pages 2-49 have identical extracted text and rendered content. First-page differences are confined to the author list and arXiv stamp.

before.justification: v3 reports original Tool-Planner evaluations on APIBench and ToolBench in Tables 2-3, alongside ablations, efficiency analyses, and additional experiments in the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains the original benchmark results, ablations, efficiency analyses, and appendix experiments reported in v3.

M1.justification: The clustering, toolkit-based planning, tool substitution, and replanning procedures in Section 3 and Algorithm 1 are identical. Appendix F retains the same DBSCAN variant.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same six ToolBench groups and APIBench's TorchHub, HuggingFace, and TensorFlow coverage. The Home Search comparison and appendix case scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical: ReACT, Reflexion, AdaPlanner, and DFSDT in Tables 2-3, plus ToolChain* in Table 6. The embedding and clustering comparisons are also unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendices B, E, and F retain identical evaluation metrics, splits, model configurations, and settings, including clustering counts and inference temperature. No experimental protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The toolkit ablations, cluster-count sensitivity, embedding comparisons, efficiency and error analyses, smaller-model experiments, and DBSCAN analysis are identical. Error examples and case studies in Appendices H and K are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical throughout the tables, plots, and experimental descriptions. No repeated-run information, seeds, uncertainty estimates, or significance tests are added or removed.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged, including appendix Tables 6-8. For example, GPT-4 Tool-Planner retains average ToolBench pass/win rates of 77.3%/77.5% in Table 3 and APIBench rates of 76.9%/82.2% in Table 2.

T1.justification: The mathematical formalization in Sections 2-3, Equations 1-4, and the proposed causal-inference formulation in Appendix G are identical. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution statements, and conclusion retain identical claims about toolkit-based planning, efficient exploration, and improved task performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations are unchanged, including dependence on clustering quality and additional latency relative to ReACT in Appendix A, smaller-model bottlenecks in Appendix E, and clustering tradeoffs in Appendix F.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, search pseudocode, and prompting templates in Appendices B, C, and J are identical. The abstract's code repository link is unchanged.

R1.justification: The citations, bibliography, related-work discussion in Section 5, and positioning against earlier planning methods are identical.

P1.justification: v4 removes Shi Bo from the first-page author list and updates the arXiv stamp from v3 dated 28 February 2025 to v4 dated 15 August 2025. Scientific prose, terminology, and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1-5, Tables 1-8, Algorithm 1, and appendix displays retain identical formatting, captions, and placement. The first-page author and stamp text edits do not reorganize the page layout.

improvement.justification: The method, empirical evidence, explanations, limitations, and appendices are identical. The byline and arXiv-stamp edits leave the paper's scientific support and expository quality unchanged.
